raw_text: ALERT: Yuan Wang 5 (MMSI 413270005) entered Indian EEZ without prior notification. Vessel classified as space and satellite tracking ship but widely assessed as SIGINT collection platform. AIS gaps of 6-12 hours observed. Indian Navy has deployed INS Sahyadri to shadow the vessel. This is third Yuan Wang-class incursion into Indian Ocean Region this year.
